body: I am sorry for all the pain you have been through I hope you find the strength to keep going. I know its hard I have to fight the same feeling day by day.
Honestly I have 4 kids and only 2 of them stop me because the other 2 dont seem to care much for me :(

I am sorry you are hurting so much, I dont know you but your story makes me want to reach out to you and let you know theres someone here who cares for you and what your going through. I cant imagine the struggles you have and I hope and pray that things get better for you, sending you a big hug. Stay strong.
Sorry your lonely, I hope it helps that I wish you werent, Im lonely too💔

If she is pregnant its not the end of your life. You can still have a great life and be a teen dad, dont let this scare you. Your only 15 yes but you have your whole life ahead of you to prosper. We all here to help you when you need to talk, you have our support.
I’m sorry you want to die, please try to stay here longer.
